name: Heman
bio: Heman son of Joel was a Levite of the Kohathite clan. When David organized the Levites to carry the ark into Jerusalem with music and singing, Heman was named first among the three chief singers, alongside Asaph and Ethan, sounding bronze cymbals as the procession moved toward the city (1 Chronicles 15:16-19). He went on to lead Israel's worship for the rest of David's reign and is credited as the namesake of Psalm 88.
